title: Matt Griebel: products and projects
subtitle: Rockets mark public launches. Dashed borders are in progress. Grey items are retired or paused.

items.title: MgGriebZ.com
items.description:
- Personal platform: calendar, events, food and game logs, with shareable pages
- Live data from the GitHub, Riot Games and TMDB APIs
- React and .NET 8 on Azure (Cosmos DB, Blob Storage); also the API behind Mg Glass and shaco
- 1,500+ commits and 435 merged pull requests since June 2025

items.title: RoadScript
items.description:
- Started when a Fortune 500 bank client asked for clearer roadmap transparency
- Visual editor for stakeholders, JSON editor for technical users
- Blazor WebAssembly on Azure Static Web Apps; no backend, data stays in the browser
- Deployed on day one, then 330+ commits and 81 merged pull requests of refinement

items.title: shaco
items.description:
- First-person field guide to AP Shaco support in League of Legends
- Pairs gameplay clips with the tricks they demonstrate
- Astro static site: the repo is the CMS, stats computed at build time from MgGriebZ.com game logs
- Written PRD and decision log; 150+ commits in its first four weeks

items.title: Core Clock
items.description:
- Third-person arena game: 12 players in 4 teams race pucks into Core sockets
- Godot and GDScript, with KayKit and Kenney assets
- Built pass by pass from a PRD and execution plans
- 690+ commits since July 2026

items.title: Action Tarot
items.description:
- Gen-AI tarot journaling app, launched in 2024
- .NET 6 MVC with GPT and DALL-E, then rebuilt in Blazor WebAssembly with Azure AD B2C and Cosmos DB
- Rebuilt as a tarot auto-battler in July 2026, now paused

items.title: Custom sites
items.description:
- Ashme Glass, Captain Hook Glass Art and Sassy Cakes
- React and Vite on Azure Static Web Apps with a .NET API
- Generalized into a public full-stack Azure site template

items.title: Late 2025 experiments
items.description:
- FlowForge: conversation puzzle game, .NET API on Azure App Service
- SalvScriptZ: RuneLite plugin that tracks OSRS salvaging sessions
- CosmoScope: .NET MAUI telescope companion

items.title: 2026 experiments
items.description:
- CosmoScope: lunar logbook and outdoor activity PWA
- Rehoboam: trading dashboard with a Claude news classifier
- Sacred Sigils: Flutter rune-tracing app, first built in 2025
- Pocket Playroom: touch-first playroom for young kids

items.title: HPP Glass
items.description:
- Showcase and admin site for two glass artists: gallery, inquiry wizard, editable taxonomy
- React 19 on Azure Static Web Apps; Functions backend keeps Cosmos DB and Blob credentials server-side
- Generalized into Mg Glass, a lampworking studio planner on the MgGriebZ.com API

items.title: AI chat
items.description:
- Code drafted in AI chat, pasted in and committed by hand
- First Codex pull request tried in June 2025

items.title: Claude Code on the web
items.description:
- From November 2025: agents work from a written plan and open pull requests; I review and merge
- 90%+ of commits in this period are authored by Claude

items.title: Local agents
items.description:
- Codex from July 2026, local Claude Code from August 2026
- Agents run against PRDs and execution plans; commits land under my name
